scope: Fixed original signed Debian binutils package build. Build, upstream test evidence, output identity and complete producer/notice closure are distinct observations. No input acquisition or model inference.

inputOrigins.scope: Public data-only origin map for the exact frozen inputs. Every downloaded dependency archive matches its filename, byte count and SHA-256 in a pinned canonical APT Packages payload. Original source-signing and APT-archive keyrings are distinct. This controller does not download, regenerate indexes or install tools on the host.
inputOrigins.availabilityScope: Historical observation at the retained receipt timestamp, not a promise of future server availability. Current reruns must revalidate every frozen byte count/hash and signature.
